title: Gap kind: model-facing work without a case
goal: The gap review flags a component that exposes MCP tools and has neither evaluations nor a project-scope skip
acceptance: New gap kind "Model-facing work without a case", worded as a prompt to check, never proof
Optional covers command in .harness.json evaluations lists the features or tools it has cases for
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first
A component with evaluations declared, or a project-scope skip for the evaluation asset, produces no gap
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one gap kind, an optional command setting and fixtures. Not a measurement.
